details:
ASTRA HEALTH — Astronaut Health Monitoring and Early Warning System

ASTRA HEALTH is a full-stack web-based application designed to monitor astronaut health information and support early identification of unusual health patterns during space missions.

The system provides centralized management of astronaut profiles, health readings, missions, medical assignments, devices, health alerts, and well-being reports. It uses configurable rule-based anomaly detection to identify unusual readings and notify authorized medical personnel.

The application supports four major user roles: Astronaut, Medical Officer, Mission Control, and Administrator. Each role receives appropriate access to health information and system functionalities. Astronauts can submit text-based or voice-based well-being reports, while medical officers can review reports, record observations, and create follow-up actions.

The application is developed using React and Vite for the frontend, Java and Spring Boot for the backend, and PostgreSQL for persistent data storage. Spring Security and JWT provide authentication and authorization. REST APIs enable communication between the frontend and backend.

The main objective is to demonstrate how centralized health monitoring, automated alerts, secure medical workflows, and data analysis can support astronaut health management and mission operations.

Keywords: Astronaut Health Monitoring, Space Technology, Spring Boot, React, PostgreSQL, JWT, Anomaly Detection, Health Analytics, Early Warning System.
